product_logic.1 visit: current == baseline == latest (same row); screen with the single available visit.
product_logic.2 visits: screen at latest available visit; no previous visit required.
product_logic.3+ visits: screen at latest available visit; ignore earlier visits for scoring.
product_logic.general: latest_visit = row with max MR Delay for the subject; baseline_visit = row with min MR Delay (0).
